Reordered by accepted pair membership

Chromosome-number distance matrix, reordered so each accepted pair sits adjacent to the diagonal instead of the pipeline's raw chromosome-number order -- resolves scattered/checkerboard-looking pairing into a clean pattern when it's just a numbering artifact; any structure that persists after reordering (e.g. tighter multi-pair blocks) is real signal beyond the individual pairs. See INTERPRETATION.md's "checkerboard" section. Undefined when there are no accepted pairs.
